_readme: A sample personality file (2026-10-16): four alerts only, for trying the format. Copy it into data/personalities/ to hear it (Settings -> Voice: Naval, sample). The real naval personality replaces it.

naval: All stations manned and ready, {name}.
Ship's company reports ready for duty, {name}.
Systems nominal. Standing by for your orders, {name}.
Bridge is yours, {name}. All departments report ready.
Watch set. Awaiting your orders, {name}.
naval_profane: All hands at their damn stations, {name}.
Ship's ready, {name}. Let's get this bloody watch started.
Everything's green and nobody's screwed it up yet, {name}.
Bridge is yours, {name}. Try not to scratch the damn paint.
Crew's awake, coffee's foul, ship's ready. Orders, {name}?

naval: Contact: uncharted system, {name}. No record on file. Logging it as ours.
First survey of {system}, {name}. Nobody has charted these waters.
Plot is clean, {name}. No prior survey of this system on record.
Uncharted territory, {name}. Mark the log: first ship in.
New system, {name}. Ours to chart.
naval_profane: Well, damn, {name}. Nobody's charted this one. It's ours.
Uncharted, {name}. First ship in, and it's bloody well us.
No record of {system} anywhere, {name}. Hell of a find.
Fresh water, {name}. Nobody's dropped anchor here. Damn fine.
Nobody's been here, {name}. Put our damn name on it.

naval: Hull integrity {pct} percent, {name}.
Damage report: hull at {pct} percent, {name}.
Hull down to {pct} percent. Recommend we break off, {name}.
{name}, hull integrity {pct} percent and falling.
Damage control reports hull at {pct} percent, {name}.
naval_profane: Hull's at {pct} percent, {name}, and that's not bloody good.
Damn it, {name}, hull's down to {pct} percent.
{pct} percent hull, {name}. We're taking a hell of a beating.
Hull at {pct}, {name}. Get us the hell out of here.
She's hurting, {name}. Hull {pct} percent, damn it.

naval: Fuel state low, {name}: {pct} percent.
{name}, fuel at {pct} percent. Recommend we refuel at the next star.
Fuel {pct} percent, {name}. Plot a course for a scoopable star.
Low fuel, {name}. {pct} percent in the tanks.
Fuel state critical soon, {name}. {pct} percent remaining.
naval_profane: Fuel's at {pct} percent, {name}. Find us a damn star.
{name}, {pct} percent fuel. We're running on fumes, damn it.
Tanks at {pct}, {name}. Don't strand us out here, for God's sake.
{pct} percent fuel, {name}. Scoop something, damn it.
Low fuel, {name}, {pct} percent. Bloody well refuel.
